question.worked_solution:
The difference of cubes formula is given by

$$
{a}^{3}-{b}^{3}=(a-b)({a}^{2}+ab+{b}^{2}).
$$

Notice that we can write our expression as a difference of cubes:

$$
\frac{{x}^{3}}{8}-\frac{{z}^{6}}{125}={(\frac{x}{2})}^{3}-{(\frac{{z}^{2}}{5})}^{3}
$$

Now, we factor the given expression using the difference of cubes formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{{x}^{3}}{8}-\frac{{z}^{6}}{125} & ={(\frac{x}{2})}^{3}-{(\frac{{z}^{2}}{5})}^{3} \\  & =(\frac{x}{2}-\frac{{z}^{2}}{5})({(\frac{x}{2})}^{2}+\frac{x}{2}\cdot \frac{{z}^{2}}{5}+{(\frac{{z}^{2}}{5})}^{2}) \\  & =(\frac{x}{2}-\frac{{z}^{2}}{5})(\frac{{x}^{2}}{4}+\frac{x{z}^{2}}{10}+\frac{{z}^{4}}{25})\end{aligned}
$$
